issues.description: The problem statement explicitly says the Person.birthday attribute must be handled as a String (ISO-8601), but both the template and the solution model, service, and tests use java.time.LocalDate for the birthday field and related logic. This mismatch is likely to confuse students (they may try to implement birthday as String) and will prevent them from following the provided tests and code examples which expect LocalDate.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the specification and the code consistent. The least-disruptive fix is to update the problem statement to state that birthday is a LocalDate (ISO-8601 representation) rather than a String, and clarify that tests and endpoints expect LocalDate values (e.g., JSON deserialized to LocalDate with Jackson modules). Alternatively, if the intention was to use Strings, change the model field to String across template and solution (and update save/get logic and tests accordingly). Given the template/tests already use LocalDate, prefer updating the problem statement to mention LocalDate handling.
